services.headline: Specialized Robotic Joint Replacement & Orthopaedic Care
services.subtext: Rekon Clinic provides focused consultations for primary and revision robotic joint replacement surgeries (knee and hip), arthroscopy, fracture fixation, and comprehensive arthritis care.
services.ctaHeadline: Consult Dr. B. V. R. N. Varma for Expert Knee, Hip, and Joint Care.

doctor.headline: Dr. B. V. R. N. Varma
doctor.subtext: Dedicated orthopedic and robotic joint replacement care in Visakhapatnam led by Dr. B. V. R. N. Varma.
doctor.backgroundDesc: Dr. B. V. R. N. Varma, MBBS, D. Ortho is a senior Consultant Orthopedic & Joint Replacement Surgeon with over 27 years of dedicated clinical and surgical excellence in Visakhapatnam. Specializing in primary & complex revision knee and hip replacements, arthroscopy, and trauma fracture fixation, his care is centered on restoring pain-free mobility and long-term joint function.
doctor.philosophyDesc: Restoring active movement and confidence is the true purpose of orthopedic care. Dr. Varma approaches every patient with meticulous clinical evaluation, customized surgical planning, and compassionate post-operative rehabilitation.
doctor.quote: My goal is to restore every patient's pain-free mobility and quality of life through advanced, patient-centric orthopedic and joint replacement care.
doctor.quoteAuthor: — Dr. B. V. R. N. Varma
